completed_at.description: Completion timestamp (RFC 3339; empty when not completed).

items.description:
One document of a signature request (the wire projection of the
stored `documents` JSONB) - a storage ref only, never inline bytes.
items.title: DocumentOut

status.description: Lifecycle state: open | completed | declined | expired | failed.

items.description:
A signer inside the evidence bundle - evidence-bearing projection
(never the list shape).

evidence.description: Provider attestation + ceremony snapshot (null when not signed).

signature_value.description: Provider-minted signature value (empty when not signed).

signed_at.description: Signature timestamp (RFC 3339; empty when not signed).

viewed_at.description: First-view timestamp (RFC 3339; empty when not viewed).

items.title: SignerEvidence

schema.description:
`GET /v1/requests/{id}/evidence` 200 body - the append-only
evidence bundle: request metadata + per-signer evidence.
schema.title: EvidenceBundle
